title: fix(plugin-list): withhold the In a queue toggle on a view whose filter pins owner_id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBM4G57dB19BKkNck4JJf8GN)_
Fixes #34580
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表工具栏的「在队列中」开关,在当前视图自己的过滤条件已经要求「负责人必须有值」(顶层 AND 里 `owner_id` 为 `equals` 某人、`in` 一组人或 `is_not_empty`)时不再显示;写在 OR 组里的负责人条件不算。开关隐藏期间不再往查询里加条件;若之前处于打开状态会被关掉,切回能显示它的视图时是关闭的。
- 为什么改:开关加的条件是「负责人为空且在某个队列里」,和「负责人 = 我」矛盾,所以在 HotCRM「我的未结商机」这类视图上打开它永远是空列表,用户会误读成「队列里没有东西」。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@object-ui/plugin-list` 的工具栏判断,不动元数据、契约和服务端;另把文档 `queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` 里描述开关何时出现的一句改成两个条件都写明。最坏情况是某个视图上开关被多藏了一次(只在负责人确实被钉死时才藏)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 `viewFilterRequiresOwner` 与它下面的 `conjunctsOf` / `requiresOwnerValue`(哪些算「顶层 AND」、哪些运算符算「必须有值」);② 同文件 `queueFilterOffered` 处新加的 `viewPinsOwner` 与重置 effect;③ `ListView.harness.test.tsx` 新增的 `ListView.queueToggleOwnerPin-34580` 块。
- 两分钟验证:在仓根执行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx -t 34580`,预期 6 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`:

- New exported `viewFilterRequiresOwner(viewFilter)`. It lowers the view's own filter through the shared `toFilterNodeSafely` (so a stored rule list, an AST and a MongoDB-style object answer alike), walks the conjuncts of the top-level AND (nested `and` nodes and implicit-AND lists included, `or` nodes skipped), and answers true when one conjunct is on `owner_id` (`SystemFieldName.OWNER_ID`) with an operator that requires a value, folded by the spec's `canonicalAstOperator`:
  - `=` (any spelling: `equals`, `eq`, `==`) with a non-empty scalar comparand;
  - `in` with a list whose every member is a non-empty scalar;
  - `is_not_empty` (any spelling; direction comes from the operator name, as the spec's lowering reads it).
  A filter the lowering refuses pins nothing here; the list already answers it with its load error.
- `queueFilterOffered` adds `&& !viewPinsOwner`, where `viewPinsOwner = viewFilterRequiresOwner(authoredFilter)` (the resolved view filter the fetch, export and empty state already read). Since `appliedQueueSittingConditions` is gated on `queueFilterOffered`, a withheld toggle contributes no condition.
- An effect lets go of a pressed state while the view pins the owner, so a view that offers the toggle again shows it off (acceptance 4). It sends no extra query: the applied conditions are already the empty constant while withheld.

No new key, no server reading, no contract change.

## Why

The toggle AND-s `owner_id is_empty` and `queue is_not_empty` (`QUEUE_SITTING_CONDITIONS`). Beside a view filter `owner_id equals {current_user_id}` (HotCRM's "My Open Deals") the conjunction has no rows whatever the data, and the user reads the empty list as "nothing is waiting in a queue". Same rule as the `hasAnyQueue` gate: offer an affordance only where it can do something.

## Tests

Added as a top-level `describe('ListView.queueToggleOwnerPin-34580')` in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx`, opening with `restoreAfterBlock()`, among the blocks that register no stand-in renderer (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes into that file, ruling record 6583487846). The toggle's existing offer rules stay pinned in `ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx`, untouched.

- `viewFilterRequiresOwner` pins on equals / in / is_not_empty across a stored rule list, an AST triple, a nested `and`, an implicit-AND list and a MongoDB-style object; it does not pin inside an OR group (stored `{ or: [...] }` and AST `or`), on `not_equals`, `is_empty`, `= null`, or an `in` list holding null.
- Acceptance 1: "My Open Deals" (`owner_id equals {current_user_id}` + `stage not_in [...]`, resolved through `FilterScopeProvider`): no toggle, and the query carries no `is_empty`.
- Acceptance 2 and 3: "All Opportunities" (no owner condition): the toggle renders off, and pressing it still AND-s both queue conditions beside the view's stage filter.
- OR group: an owner condition inside `{ or: [...] }` keeps the toggle.
- Acceptance 4: one mount, the view filter changed by `rerender`: pressed on the unpinned view, then the pinned view shows no toggle and its query has no `is_empty`, then back on the unpinned view the toggle is shown with `aria-pressed="false"` and the query has no queue condition.

## Acceptance notes

- In the console the host remounts `ListView` per view (`identityKey` in app-shell's `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`), so a view switch there already resets the toggle; the rerender pin covers hosts that hand one instance a new `filter`.
- A one-member any-of group `{ or: [rule] }` is lowered by `toFilterNode` to the bare rule, so it pins: it is logically the same condition. Groups of two or more members do not pin.
- Docs (round 2, L1-a REWORK 6938675239): `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`, the sentence on when the **In a queue** toggle shows, now names both shipped conditions: the organization has at least one queue, and the view's own filter does not require `owner_id` to hold a value. The file joined the claim surface by the seat's amendment 6938684810.
- Open question (not implemented, per the card): per-object narrowing. Measured in this repository at `144cdc25`: the only client-visible queue signal is the organization-wide boolean `hasAnyQueue` on `GET /auth/me/permissions` (no names, no counts, nothing per object), and the `queue` column is injected on every `ownership: 'user'` object. So no per-object signal exists to read without a new server reading; it stays the maintainer's ruling the card raises.
